title: add-rag-fuzzplayground-simulator-templates
description: Introduce the RAG FuzzPlayground quickstart: a lightweight, reproducible toolkit for generating adversarial and edge-case RAG sessions and replaying them against local and hosted Redwood endpoints. Motivation: teams need a fast way to surface prompt brittleness, hallucination triggers, and caching/kv-cache edge cases before rolling model changes to production. This quickstart provides (1) a TypeScript CLI that synthesizes randomized user sessions and adversarial prompt perturbations, (2) a Python evaluation harness for batch runs and differential outputs (pytest-friendly), (3) a small webhook adapter to stub external tool calls and HTTP responses for reproducible end-to-end tests, and (4) telemetry hooks + example Grafana/Prometheus metric labels to aid local observability. The PR contains templates, CI smoke tests, README with usage examples, a minimal Dockerfile for local emulation, and a short tutorial notebook for manual exploration. Usage: yarn install && yarn build && node dist/cli/fuzzplayground.js --target http://localhost:8080 --profile adversarial-small --count 50. The description, examples, and test vectors emphasize safe defaults and non-destructive fuzz data (no real user data). Related Linear items: ENG-7864 (fuzz test harness), PM-321 (quickstart deliverable).
